chapters.title: Introduction to Sociology
chapters.shortIntro: NEB Grade 12 humanities stream: Introduction to Sociology.

introduction.overview:
Introduction to Sociology is a crucial chapter in the NEB Grade 12 Sociology syllabus under the humanities stream. This chapter is designed according to the NEB curriculum framework and covers both theoretical and applied aspects of the topic.

Students studying in the humanities stream at Grade 12 level will find this chapter essential for their board examinations. The NEB has consistently included questions from this chapter, making it a priority for exam preparation.

The content builds on secondary-level knowledge and introduces concepts at a higher academic level. Students should regularly practice problems and review past NEB question papers to understand the examination pattern.

By mastering this chapter, students will develop a strong conceptual foundation that will serve them well in higher education, whether pursuing a bachelor's degree or preparing for entrance examinations.
introduction.whyItMatters: This chapter is frequently tested in NEB Grade 12 examinations. A strong grasp of Introduction to Sociology provides both examination success and practical knowledge for future studies.

topics.name: Introduction to Introduction to Sociology
topics.explanation:
This topic provides a comprehensive introduction to Introduction to Sociology as studied in Grade 12 humanities stream. The fundamental concepts, definitions, and principles are covered here.

Students should aim to understand the conceptual basis thoroughly, as NEB questions often test understanding rather than mere recall.
keyPoints: Core principles of Introduction to Sociology
topics.examTip: NEB Grade 12 often includes short-answer questions testing conceptual clarity. Be precise in your definitions.

topics.name: Applications of Introduction to Sociology
topics.explanation: This topic explores how the concepts of Introduction to Sociology are applied in practical scenarios and examination contexts. Problem-solving skills are developed through guided examples and practice.
topics.examTip: For long-answer questions in NEB exams, structure your response with an introduction, main body with examples, and conclusion.
